description: This file implements the control service logic for E2SM-CCC, including control request handling, style definition, and executor management within a 3GPP-related system.

classes.name: e2sm_ccc_control_service
classes.description: Main control service class handling style 1 and managing control action executors.

classes.name: e2sm_ccc_control_service_style_2
classes.description: Derived class for style 2 control service with specific request validation and execution logic.

methods.name: get_control_style_definition
methods.description: Returns the control style definition; currently a placeholder.

methods.name: get_style_type
methods.description: Returns the style ID of the control service.

methods.name: add_e2sm_rc_control_action_executor
methods.description: Adds a control action executor to the service.

methods.name: control_request_supported
methods.description: Validates if a control request is supported based on style and configuration.

methods.name: execute_control_request
methods.description: Executes a control request asynchronously if supported.
